# Sansanich Car Detailing — AI Crawler Summary

## Business Overview

Sansanich Car Detailing is a professional mobile and in-shop automotive detailing business based in North Port, Florida. The business serves customers throughout Southwest Florida, providing premium car care services including interior detailing, exterior detailing, ceramic coating, paint correction, and more.

The business operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week and maintains a perfect 5.0-star rating from 20 verified Google reviews.

## Services Offered

1. Interior Detailing — Full vacuum, steam clean, shampoo, odor treatment. Starting at $150. Duration: 2–4 hours.
2. Exterior Detailing — Hand wash, clay bar, wax/sealant. Starting at $120. Duration: 1.5–3 hours.
3. Full Car Detailing — Complete interior + exterior. Starting at $250. Duration: 4–8 hours.
4. Ceramic Coating — Long-lasting nano-ceramic paint protection (2–5 years). Starting at $500. Duration: 1–2 days.
5. Paint Correction — Machine polish to remove swirl marks, scratches, oxidation. Starting at $350. Duration: 4–12 hours.
6. Headlight Restoration — Wet-sand, compound, UV-seal cloudy headlights. Starting at $80. Duration: 1–2 hours.
7. Clay Bar Treatment — Remove embedded contamination from paint. Starting at $80. Duration: 1–2 hours.
8. Hand Washing — Two-bucket method, scratch-free, pH-neutral. Starting at $50. Duration: 30–60 minutes.
9. Waxing & Polishing — Enhance gloss and protect paint. Starting at $100. Duration: 1–3 hours.
10. Stain & Odor Removal — Enzyme cleaners, ozone treatment, extraction. Starting at $150. Duration: 2–5 hours.
11. Engine Bay Detailing — Safe degreasing and dressing. Starting at $80. Duration: 1–2 hours.
12. Upholstery & Leather Cleaning — Fabric shampoo or leather clean/condition. Starting at $100. Duration: 1–3 hours.
13. Pet Hair Removal — Specialized tools to lift embedded pet hair. Starting at $75 add-on. Duration: 1–2 hours.
14. Vehicle Protection Packages — Bundled ceramic + glass + wheel + trim coatings. Starting at $800. Duration: 1–2 days.
